reading.families_come_from: the record, not this file -- renaming one there makes a roster claim stop resolving
reading.membership_is_a_claim: stated in ci/workspace.yaml by a person, never inferred from a dependency graph or a commit date
reading.unstated_is_not_none: a repository with no family has not been placed; nobody answered the question
reading.do_not: read a family as a statement that anybody is working on it -- that is `attention`, and it is a different claim

families.name: core
families.drives: the corpus and its tooling — governance, the archive, the deltas, the maps, the language data

families.name: infra
families.drives: where a thing runs, and how it is reached — ingress, identity, storage, DNS, observability, the network path

families.name: instruments
families.drives: the sound — looping, synthesis, tempo, remote control surfaces

families.name: irl
families.drives: matter — a thing somebody builds, holds or installs: parts, boards, enclosures, and the firmware that makes one work

families.name: performer-display
families.drives: the performer — what a player reads while playing

families.name: show-control
families.drives: the room — cues, lighting, sound and video playback, audio transport
